name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.filter_ge_eq_filter_gt
statement:
lemma filter_ge_eq_filter_gt (b : SeqZ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∉ b.support) :
    b.support.filter (fun i => n ≤ i) = b.support.filter (fun i => n < i)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.filter_ge_eq_insert_filter_gt
statement:
lemma filter_ge_eq_insert_filter_gt (b : SeqZ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ b.support) :
    b.support.filter (fun i => n ≤ i) = insert n (b.support.filter (fun i => n < i))

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.finFunToSeq_apply_lt
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finFunToSeq_apply_lt (N n : ℕ) (hn : n < N) (v : Fin N → ℤ) :

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.finFunToSeq_apply_not_lt
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finFunToSeq_apply_not_lt (N n : ℕ) (hn : ¬ n < N) (v : Fin N → ℤ) :

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeHomDiscreteEquiv_map
statement:
lemma freeHomDiscreteEquiv_map {T T' : LightProfinite} (φ : T' ⟶ T)
    (f : (LightCondensed.free R).obj T.toCondensed ⟶
      (LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat R)).obj M) :
    freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T' M
        ((LightCondensed.free R).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ) ≫ f) =
      (freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T M f).comap φ.hom.hom

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeHomDiscreteEquiv_sub_apply
statement:
lemma freeHomDiscreteEquiv_sub_apply
    (f g : (LightCondensed.free R).obj T.toCondensed ⟶
      (LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat R)).obj M)
    (x : T) :
    freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T M (f - g) x =
      freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T M f x - freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T M g x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeHomDiscreteEquiv_zero_apply
statement:
lemma freeHomDiscreteEquiv_zero_apply (x : T) :
    freeHomDiscreteEquiv R T M
      (0 : (LightCondensed.free R).obj T.toCondensed ⟶
        (LightCondensed.discrete (ModuleCat R)).obj M) x = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv_precomp_left
statement:
lemma freeProductHomEquiv_precomp_left {A' A S : LightProfinite} (φ : A' ⟶ A)
    (g : ((free ℤ).obj A.toCondensed ⊗ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc)) :
    freeProductHomEquiv A' S
        (((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ) ▷
            (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ g) =
      (freeProductHomEquiv A S g).comap (φ ⊗ₘ 𝟙 S).hom.hom

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv_sub_apply
statement:
lemma freeProductHomEquiv_sub_apply (A S : LightProfinite)
    (f g : (free ℤ).obj A.toCondensed ⊗ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc)
    (x : (A ⊗ S : LightProfinite)) :
    freeProductHomEquiv A S (f - g) x =
      freeProductHomEquiv A S f x - freeProductHomEquiv A S g x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeProductHomEquiv_zero_apply
statement:
lemma freeProductHomEquiv_zero_apply (A S : LightProfinite) (x : (A ⊗ S : LightProfinite)) :
    freeProductHomEquiv A S
      (0 : (free ℤ).obj A.toCondensed ⊗ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed ⟶ Zdisc) x = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.freeTensorIsoInt_inv_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma freeTensorIsoInt_inv_naturality_left {A' A S : LightProfinite} (φ : A' ⟶ A) :
    (freeTensorIsoInt A' S).inv ≫
        ((free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map φ) ▷ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) =
      (free ℤ).map (lightProfiniteToLightCondSet.map (φ ⊗ₘ 𝟙 S)) ≫
        (freeTensorIsoInt A S).inv

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.ihomPoints_pre_app
statement:
lemma ihomPoints_pre_app
    {A B X : LightCondMod R} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : ((ihom A).obj X).obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    ihomPoints R B X S
      ((((MonoidalClosed.pre f).app X).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x)
      = (f ▷ (LightCondensed.free R).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ ihomPoints R A X S x

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.ihom_pre_val_app
statement:
lemma ihom_pre_val_app
    {A B X : LightCondMod R} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (S : LightProfinite)
    (x : ((ihom A).obj X).obj.obj ⟨S⟩) :
    (((MonoidalClosed.pre f).app X).hom.app ⟨S⟩) x =
      (ihomPoints R B X S).symm
        ((f ▷ (LightCondensed.free R).obj S.toCondensed) ≫ ihomPoints R A X S x)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.iotaTensorMap_apply
statement:

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.nullSeqPointsEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma nullSeqPointsEquiv_apply (S : LightProfinite)
    (f : (P ℤ ⊗ (free ℤ).obj S.toCondensed) ⟶ Zdisc) (s : S) (n : ℕ) :
    nullSeqPointsEquiv S f s n =
      numeratorHomEquiv S ((pTensorHomSubtypeEquiv S f).1) ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.pTensorHomSubtypeEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
lemma pTensorHomSubtypeEquiv_apply_coe (S : LightProfinite)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqDiff_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma seqDiff_apply (a : SeqZ) (n : ℕ) :
    seqDiff a n = a n - a (n + 1)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqDiff_eq_zero
statement: lemma seqDiff_eq_zero {a : SeqZ} (h : seqDiff a = 0) : a = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqDiff_seqTailSum
statement:
lemma seqDiff_seqTailSum (b : SeqZ) :
    seqDiff (seqTailSum b) = b

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqShift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma seqShift_apply (a : SeqZ) (n : ℕ) :
    seqShift a n = a (n + 1)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqTailSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma seqTailSum_apply (b : SeqZ) (n : ℕ) :
    seqTailSum b n = ∑ i ∈ b.support.filter (fun i => n ≤ i), b i

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqTailSum_seqDiff
statement:
lemma seqTailSum_seqDiff (a : SeqZ) :
    seqTailSum (seqDiff a) = a

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqToVanish_apply_infty
statement:
lemma seqToVanish_apply_infty {S : LightProfinite} (g : LocallyConstant S SeqZ) (s : S) :
    (seqToVanish g).1 ((∞ : ℕ∪{∞}), s) = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seqToVanish_apply_nat
statement:
lemma seqToVanish_apply_nat {S : LightProfinite} (g : LocallyConstant S SeqZ) (s : S) (n : ℕ) :
    (seqToVanish g).1 ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) = g s n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.seq_family_eventually_zero
statement:
lemma seq_family_eventually_zero {S : LightProfinite} (g : LocallyConstant S SeqZ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ s : S, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → g s n = 0

lemma seq_family_support_finite {S : LightProfinite} (g : LocallyConstant S SeqZ) :

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.sub_whiskerRight
statement:
lemma sub_whiskerRight {X Y C : LightCondAb} (f g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (f - g) ▷ C = f ▷ C - g ▷ C

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.tailFun_eq_sum_filter
statement:
lemma tailFun_eq_sum_filter (b : SeqZ) (n : ℕ) :
    tailFun b n = ∑ i ∈ b.support.filter (fun i => n ≤ i), b i

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.tailFun_sub_succ
statement:
lemma tailFun_sub_succ (b : SeqZ) (n : ℕ) :
    tailFun b n - tailFun b (n + 1) = b n

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.tensorCokerIsoInt_π_inv
statement:
lemma tensorCokerIsoInt_π_inv {C : LightCondAb} :
    cokernel.π (P_map ℤ ▷ C) ≫

      P_proj ℤ ▷ C

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.truncIndexFun_eventually_none
statement:
lemma truncIndexFun_eventually_none (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, truncIndexFun N (n : ℕ∪{∞}) = none

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.vanishToSeq_apply
statement:
lemma vanishToSeq_apply {S : LightProfinite} (h : VanishAtInfinity S) (s : S) (n : ℕ) :
    vanishToSeq h s n = h.1 ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s)

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.vanish_eventually_zero
statement:
lemma vanish_eventually_zero {S : LightProfinite} (h : VanishAtInfinity S) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ s : S, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → h.1 ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) = 0

name: LightCondensed.Solid.IntProof.vanish_supportN_finite
statement:
lemma vanish_supportN_finite {S : LightProfinite} (h : VanishAtInfinity S) :
    Set.Finite {n : ℕ | ∃ s : S, h.1 ((n : ℕ∪{∞}), s) ≠ 0}
